I have successfully retrieved the calendars for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. Now I need to find the common 30-minute free slots for them and share this information with Brad.

- Tue: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wed: 12:30-13:00, 15:00-16:00
- Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-10:30, 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00
- Fri: 11:00-12:00, 13:00-13:30, 14:00-14:30

**Marcus's Free Slots:**
- Mon: 09:00-10:00, 11:00-11:30, 15:00-15:30
- Tue: 11:00-11:30, 13:00-14:00, 15:30-16:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wed: 09:00-09:30, 12:00-12:30, 14:00-14:30, 15:00-16:00
- Thu: 10:00-10:30, 12:00-12:30
- Fri: 11:00-12:00, 14:30-15:00

**Common 30-minute slots:**
- Mon: 09:00, 09:30
- Tue: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
- Wed: 15:00, 15:30
- Thu: 10:00
- Fri: 11:00, 11:30

Now I will add this list of available slots to the workspace for Brad. This will allow him to check these times against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
